definition: nowcast(M) = 0.5*BRIDGE(M) + 0.5*CLAIMS(M); target = coincident composite for month M (mean expanding-z, min 120 obs, of 6m annualized log growth of PAYEMS, INDPRO, W875RX1, CMRMTSPL); issued at the payrolls release ~1 week after month M ends, ~1 month before the composite for M prints (~2 months before CMRMTSPL completes it)
refit_policy: all regressions OLS, expanding window, refit monthly; coefficients below are the current full-history fit and will drift slightly each refit

BRIDGE.description: mean of the four coincident z-scores: PAYEMS actual (published at nowcast date); INDPRO/W875RX1/CMRMTSPL growth projected then z-scored with expanding stats (min 120 obs) through each component's last actual month

CLAIMS.description: regression on current-month weekly-claims and yield-curve z plus last composite; z_claims6 = expanding z of -2*ln(ICSA_M/ICSA_{M-6}) on monthly-mean ICSA; z_curve = expanding z of T10Y3M monthly mean (GS10-TB3MS before 1982)

weights.note: fixed, not fitted; ex-ante walk-forward grid selector (ENS_GRID) chose exactly this combo in 354/630 months and matches its RMSE (0.3319)

dm_stat_vs_persistence.note: Newey-West lag 6; negative = better than persistence; full-sample significance diluted by 2020 tail

stats.false_alarm_note: 1981-06 preceded the 1981-08 recession (realized crossing 1981-11); no genuine false positives 1972-2026

early_warning_channel.note: display as separate trigger line; earlier on 1981(+6m), 2001(+2m), 2008(+3m), 2020(+1m); never later; only pre-recession 'false' alarms (1981-06/07)

caveats: final-vintage data throughout (revisions not modeled; applies to all methods incl. baseline)
50/50 combo membership chosen with knowledge of member results; validated by ex-ante ENS_GRID convergence to same combo
CMRMTSPL(M-2) release lands ~1 week after payrolls-day nowcast; use mid-month issue or lag-3 bridge in production
COIN(M-1) regressor treated as fully known; in production use bridge-completed COIN(M-1)
